curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When a man's violent alter ego begins steering his actions, can he ever wrest back command of his own life?
curatedMovie.description: Directed by Bruce A. Evans, this crime thriller follows a man struggling to maintain control as he is repeatedly overtaken by an alter ego with a taste for murder and mayhem.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Suspenseful, measured, and psychological, offering a focused crime-thriller experience ideal for solitary viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Built on psychological tension, this crime thriller pulls viewers into the precarious balance of a man wrestling with his own homicidal impulses.
